item: Using technical commands instead of descriptive prompts (e.g., 'BFS head face swap')
Specifying 'photograph' when output is AI-generated (causes style mismatch)
Over-specifying medium with contradictory terms (e.g., 'hyperrealistic 8K cinematic' for AI)
Using LoRA at extreme scales (1.0+ causes artifacts, <0.3 has no effect)
Mixing conflicting style terms like 'painterly' with 'photorealistic'
Excessive length without clear structure or sectioning
